data.name: Himayat
data.gender_notes: Himayat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-m-y, meaning 'to protect' or 'to guard'. In Islamic history, Himayat was a title of respect given to those entrusted with the protection of sacred sites, religious leaders, or community members. The name Himayat carries the meaning “Protection, Guardianship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Himayat usually hope their child will grow to embody protection, guardianship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of protection, guardianship, and care
data.etymology: Himayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protection, Guardianship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Himayat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حماية
in_arabic.meaning: حماية تعني الحماية والرعاية والعناية الإلهية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حماية مشتق من الجذر العربي حمى، والذي يعني الحماية والرعاية. في القرآن الكريم، نجد أن الله تعالى يقول: 'والله يحمي المؤمنين' (آل عمران: ١٢٤). الحماية هي فضل من الله تعالى على عباده، وهي تعبر عن الرعاية والعناية الإلهية للمسلمين. اسم حماية يدل على معنى الحفظ والرعاية، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني دينية وروحانية عالية.

in_urdu.name: حمایت
in_urdu.meaning: حمایت کا مطلب ہے حفاظت، نگہداشت اور الہی رکاوٹ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمایت نام عربی جڑ حمى سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت یا نگہداشت. قرآن کریم میں، اللہ تعالیٰ کا ارشاد ہے: 'والله يحمي المؤمنين' (آل عمران: ١٢٤). یہ نام مسلم عبادت گزاروں کے لیے الہی نگہداشت اور حفاظت کی علامت ہے. حمایت نام رکھنے کا مطلب ہے کہ بچہ محفوظ رہے اور الہی حفاظت میں رہے.

in_hindi.name: हिमायत
in_hindi.meaning: हिमायत का अर्थ है सुरक्षा, देखभाल और ईश्वरीय संरक्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिमायत नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ حمى से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा या देखभाल. कुरआन में, अल्लाह तआला का फरमान है: 'والله يحمي المؤمنين' (आल इमरान: १२४). यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में ईश्वरीय सुरक्षा और देखभाल की भावना को दर्शाता है. हिमायत नाम रखने का तात्पर्य है कि बच्चा सुरक्षित और संरक्षित रहे.

in_pashto.name: حمایت
in_pashto.meaning: حمایت معنی دى حفاظت، پالنه او الهي مرسته
in_pashto.long_meaning: حمایت نوم د عربي ريښې حمى څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې حفاظت او پالنه ده. په قرآن کريم کې، الله تعالی فرمايي: 'والله يحمي المؤمنين' (آل عمران: ١٢۴). دا نوم د مسلمانانو لپاره د الهي پالنې او حفاظت نښه ده. حمايت نوم اخستل د دې معنی ده چې ماشوم خوندي او په الهي حفاظت کې پاتې شي.

in_english.name: Himayat
in_english.meaning: Himayat means protection, care, and divine support
in_english.long_meaning: The name Himayat originates from the Arabic root حمى (hamā), which means protection or care. In the Quran, Allah says: 'And Allah protects the believers' (Âl-i İmrân: 124). This name signifies divine protection and care for Muslims. Himayat conveys the meaning of preservation, guardianship, and spiritual support. It reflects the Islamic concept of divine providence and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Himayat" carries a profound cultural significance, particularly in the context of Islamic history and society. It represents the virtues of loyalty, faithfulness, and dedication. Those who earned this title were often entrusted with high levels of responsibility and honor, such as protecting sacred sites or religious leaders. The concept of Himayat also highlights the importance of community and mutual support, as the protection of individuals and communal values were considered essential components of a just and harmonious society.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the term "Himayat" encapsulates the idea of sheltering, shielding, and safeguarding valuable aspects of faith and belief. It serves as a reminder of the protective nature of God, who said in the Quran, "God is the Protector of those who have faith" (Quran 5:55). The term also evokes the practice of guarding one's thoughts, words, and actions against harm, as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "The cause of a man's ruin is the temptation of his own soul." Thus, the pursuit of Himayat represents a personal commitment to maintaining the sanctity of one's faith and morals.
